name: claude-micro-bridge
description: macOS tmux bridge daemon connecting Claude Code sessions to the Work Louder Codex Micro.

scripts.check: for source in src/*.mjs tools/*.mjs; do node --check "$source" || exit 1; done && zsh -n src/tmux-start-bridge.sh && zsh -n src/tmux-stop-bridge.sh && zsh -n src/tmux-reset-bridge.sh
